correctness.rationale: For each n at least six, the local gap equivalence is proved directly from four distinct step-one/step-two neighbors. The 4-gap incidences give a<=b and n<=3|F|. Constructive gap words attain ceil(n/3). The deficit equation 2b+c-a=0,1,2 exhausts all optimal words and forces the special 1,4,1,4 only at n=10. Rooted gap-word double counting yields the stated labels and counts. An independent direct-definition verifier exhaustively tests all nonempty subsets for n=6..14 (32,695) and all sizes up to the proposed minimum for n=6..24 (3,264,250). Those are finite checks, not an infinite proof.

The all-n structural gap classification and counting of all optimizers refine numerical bounds across an infinite canonical circulant family. The arithmetic residue regimes and unique 10-vertex exceptional minimum pattern make the exact obstruction layer mathematically informative for optimization and zero-forcing applications; this is not a routine single-graph calculation.
